title: Deligne–Drinfeld Freeness Conjecture for grt_1
exact_target: Is the graded Grothendieck--Teichm\"uller Lie algebra freely generated by exactly one generator in each odd weight starting at three?

sources.citation: Florian Naef and Thomas Willwacher, Numerical computation of linearized KV and the Deligne-Drinfeld and Broadhurst-Kreimer conjectures (2025 preprint).
